summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting, but did not run tests, mypy, or Black, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the escape formatting entry (ESC ]0; title BEL) and Control.title; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only via module marker) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. No commits made. Choices: the Console test skips on sys.platform == "win32"; the changelog wording names Console.set_window_title.
